description: This Java class models the <connection-factory> element in the entity configuration for the OFBiz framework. It is responsible for parsing the class attribute from an XML element and providing access to it.

classes.name: ConnectionFactory
classes.description: A final class that represents the <connection-factory> XML element in the configuration, encapsulating the class attribute and handling its parsing and validation.

methods.name: ConnectionFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ConnectionFactory object by parsing the class attribute from the provided XML element, throwing an exception if the attribute is missing or empty.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Accessor method that returns the stored class name attribute.
